correctness.rationale: For L_n=P_n□K2 with f(1,0)=0, the triangular unimodular change to rung slopes s_i∈[−1,1] and horizontal top slopes u_i makes each u_i admissible on an interval of length 2−|s_i−s_{i−1}|. Fubini yields V_n=<1,T^(n−1)1>, T having positive-semidefinite Gram kernel 2−|x−y| on [-1,1]. The resolvent u=(I−zT)^−1 1 solves u=−2zu with the even Robin-type endpoint equation, giving GF 2sin(sqrt(2z))/[sqrt(2z)(cos(sqrt(2z))−sqrt(2z)sin(sqrt(2z)))]. The even eigenfunctions cos(ρ_jx) satisfy tanρ_j=1/ρ_j; spectral weights 4/[ρ_j²(ρ_j²+2)] are strictly positive, giving exact series, strict Cauchy–Schwarz log-convexity and ratio limit 2/ρ_0². Independently computed 240-point Gaussian–Legendre discretized-kernel iterates for n=1..7 and compared every V_n to given exact rational values (relative errors <5e−5); finite quadrature only checks the analytic proof, not exhaustive n.
